info.description: Principal-aware model gateway and administration API.
info.title: gorouter API

get.description: Lists API-key metadata after applying principal ownership, organization context, status, and pagination filters.

post.description: Creates an owned API key and returns its plaintext secret exactly once in the response.

get.description: Lists models that the current principal may assign to an API key, including effective pricing.

delete.description: Permanently deletes an API key after checking ownership and management permission.

patch.description: Changes mutable API-key policy fields such as enabled state, model allowlist, scopes, quota, and RPM.

post.description: Replaces an API key secret and returns the new plaintext secret exactly once.
